title: Research: the 510-vertex W(7,2) signing of line-system-saturation 11.1 does not exist (negative result, no kappa claim)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"Matarener"} -->
_Requested by **Mark**_

## Change and mathematical scope

**Before:** `research/line-system-saturation` (#2244) §11.1 left open whether the doubled non-collinearity graph of W(7,2) has a ±1 signing S with S² = 60S + 256I (510 unit lines in ℝ³⁰, |cos| ∈ {0, 1/4}, saturated). It calls this the cheapest decisive object for saturation at k′ = 4, 5.

**After:** it does not exist. A short hand proof (status: proof) descends to the 120-line rung in ℝ²⁴ (#2244 Prop. D1), puts it in frame form, and shows that two classes sharing one 8-coordinate block are already incompatible. The finite steps are checked exhaustively in `verify.py`. The same proof rules out the 252-line rung in ℝ²⁸ and the 1023-line cos 1/4 candidate in ℝ³¹, which #2244 notes descends to this object.

This is a paper-side negative result scoped as in #2244. It makes no κ, supplier or record claim. Saturated systems with several angles (§11.3) and non-dense pairings (§11.4) stay open.

## Task and overlap

- Base `ff3cc58e370d0f678e529246f8c73e8094e18fcf`.
- Card `complex-new-helper-inventory`, scope **changed**: this settles one candidate new local unit (the reason is in TASK.json).
- Only overlap: #2244, whose §11.1 says "not attempted here". No other PR touches the signing.

## Validation

- `python3 -B research/line-system-510-signing-nonexistence/verify.py`: standard library only, about 1 s, registered. `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`, metadata `PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS`.
- The checks cover:
  - the input binding to #2244 §11.1;
  - the W(3,2) frame-form combinatorics;
  - lemmas (a) and (b) by enumeration, and the Step 4 arithmetic;
  - a positive control: 48 lines in ℝ¹⁶ built exactly, with two failure controls;
  - Delsarte inequalities, which pass for every rung, so two-point LP cannot decide this.
- Provenance only, not registered: CP-SAT (ortools 9.15) on the two-class sub-test returned INFEASIBLE in 559 s, and in 1319 s without the redundant column constraints. The k′ = 1 control and the one-class instance are FEASIBLE and verified exactly. Logs are in `logs/`. The solver gives no certificate; the hand proof is the claim.

## Credit

The question, Theorem G, descent and counts are from #2244. Prepared for Mark (Matarener) with substantial Claude (Anthropic) assistance.

## Open next questions

These are in README/TASK.json: saturated W(7,2) systems with several angles (first step: extend the frame/two-class argument with free angles), and non-dense pairings.
